Players Committee card image of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” Uploaded unchanged.
